decisions.decision: Build automation 9 now in the attendee funnel worker for the challenge shape. Steps: (1) Add a daily survey route (POST /challenge/day/:n) that stores answers in the funnel D1. (2) Run those answers through the attendee's connected AI key to produce the day's output. (3) Render it as a live HTML link (/out/:day/:token) and as a PDF made with Cloudflare Browser Rendering, stored next to the link. (4) Send it by email through Resend (or the Tantra campaign) and by WhatsApp through a Tantra campaign import, never Twilio. Log an output_delivered event on the contact timeline. In jobs-day2.ts line 861, replace the hardcoded 'not built' with a real check: a simulated day submits a survey and passes only when the PDF link comes back delivered. All write paths use the simulator. Add the auto notes to s4-challenge.ts. Mark X076 and X098 fixed in AUDIT.md with the commit. Mark X082 'partial: automation 9 done, waits on T-260 (X077)'. Then unhold T-136.
